currentWork.title: FINAL.31 highway-candidate preference — validated, ready for production
currentWork.releaseStatus: PR #160 clean head 9b9341deb58241ce79b698c9e5ea6cb98a9e4224 is validated. Clean Preview dpl_6v1R5UBYRSuxw5utwiSDX6vXswaL is READY and the temporary provider probe is removed.
rootCause: FINAL.30 highway ON only allowed highways/tollways and requested fastest routing; it did not require or prefer a returned route that actually contained a motorway.
If ORS judged an all-surface route optimal, FINAL.30 accepted it unchanged even while the MAP control showed highway ON.
The public ORS API does not expose a direct prefer-highway weighting for driving-hgv, but it does support alternative route candidates.
scope: Highway ON requests up to 3 ORS alternative HGV routes using target_count=3, share_factor=0.85 and weight_factor=1.8.
Selection priority is motorway candidate first, then tollway-only candidate, then the normal optimal route only when no highway/toll candidate exists.
Among candidates with the same priority, select the lowest duration and then lowest distance.
Highway OFF remains strict and requests no alternatives while avoiding highways+tollways+ferries.
Invalid optional alternative candidates are ignored; the primary route must still validate fail-closed.
FINAL.30 MAP toggle/persistence, FINAL.29 route classification/colors, fullscreen PIN behavior, HGV dimensions/weight, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain unchanged.
